from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
b=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill");f=b/'validation/feedback-forward/neutral-targeted-v4/native';out=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill/validation/feedback-forward/neutral-review/pass4")
o=json.loads((f/'observation.json').read_text())
specs=[
('replaced/full-layout','passed',list(range(12,20)),'Original full-state frames show heading, summary, revision B, review count 1, cards 01 through 06, review action, cards 07 through 10, and end note in that order. Neutral card surfaces and vertical gaps distinguish sections; no horizontal clipping, overlap, missing card or reordering is visible. The independently recomputed native interval union reaches top and real bottom. Viewport edge cuts in individual scroll frames are covered by overlap, not content truncation. Single-reviewer visual judgment only.'),
('replaced/text-wrapping','passed',list(range(12,20)),'At the actual 400 pt light/LTR/large environment, the complete original sequence shows the title, summary, ten headings and bodies, action label and end note readable with natural wrapping and no visible ellipsis or text truncation. This is visual readability, not measured font/padding or evidence for narrow280-large.'),
('replaced/action-appearance','failed',[16,17],'The disabled review action is rounded and its label fits, but its pale label and near-white fill visibly depart from the approved dark-gray text #55616C and gray fill #DCE2E7 at reference:/visual/disabledAction. The original native control is disabled and 52 pt high, so this finding is limited to rendered appearance. A post-capture whole-control histogram independently records dominant #EDF0F3 and a common glyph color #A1A8AF; it is diagnostic support, not a preapproved pixel test. Source cause and independent attribution remain unconfirmed.')]
]
decisions=[]
for rid,status,indices,reason in specs:
 evidence=[{'path':o['snapshots'][i]['screenshot'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256((f/o['snapshots'][i]['screenshot']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for i in indices]
 decisions.append({'id':rid,'method':'visual','status':status,'reason':reason,'snapshot_indices':indices,'evidence':evidence})
manual={'observation_sha256':hashlib.sha256((f/'observation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'decisions':decisions}
(out/'manual-legacy.json').write_text(json.dumps(manual,indent=2)+'\n')
notes={'review_mode':'legacy SHA-bound single-reviewer observations; no atomic policy or two-judge acceptance claim','raw_visual_assertions':decisions,'unassessed_visual':[{'id':'replaced/neutral-surfaces','reason':'Cards look neutral, canvas white, and main/secondary text distinct. The approved clause combines multiple exact rendered colors. No preapproved pixel sampling/ownership policy exists in the sealed inputs, so exact color compliance is retained as unverified.'}],'incidental_images':[{'snapshot_index':7,'observation':'Before tap, Mark notes reviewed has dark blue-gray fill and white text.'},{'snapshot_index':8,'observation':'After real tap, Review marked retains enabled appearance.'},{'snapshot_index':10,'observation':'After caller update, Review marked is disabled and visibly lighter, consistent with replacement frames 16 and 17. This action-2 frame is supplemental; state verdict uses approved replaced scan.'}],'known_limits':['No second independent judge supplied or spawned.','No approved atomic policy, pixel sampling rules or opaque ARGB/Boolean manual atoms.','No production change or new native execution authorized.','Visible appearance discrepancy does not prove source root cause or physical hit-area failure.']}
(out/'visual-observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(notes,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'manual_decisions':[(d['id'],d['status']) for d in decisions],'unassessed':'replaced/neutral-surfaces','observation_sha256':manual['observation_sha256']},indent=2))
